purpose: Tier 2 proof, second try: Kling v3 Standard doing clip03's repetitive clearing as three 2 s hard-jump-cut beats across the work area, landing on the approved CP03 still. Same stills, builder, location and structure as attempt 4, with each shot prompt cut to Kling's 512-character limit.

stills.source: manual ChatGPT, approved in the stills folder

multi_prompt.prompt: Shot 1 of 3, opening on the first image. By the end door at the near end of the railcar, the same bearded builder wheels the wheelbarrow in from the bottom of frame and shovels brush into it: scoop, lift, dump, repeat. Each scoop visibly removes that brush and it lands in the barrow. Same rusted railcar, same locked camera. Debris moves only on his shovel; nothing morphs or vanishes. The patch by the door turns to bare earth.

Shot 2 of 3, after a hard cut - time has passed. Same builder, same railcar, same locked camera. He now works a second stretch farther along the long side, deeper in frame: scoop, lift, dump into the wheelbarrow, full cycle each time. Behind him the ground by the end door is already bare and a brush pile has grown at the edge of the clearing. Debris moves only on his shovel; nothing morphs or vanishes.

Shot 3 of 3, after a hard cut - time has passed. Same builder, same railcar, same locked camera. Back in the foreground at the car's near end beside the track, he drops a last shovelful into the loaded wheelbarrow. The strip along the long side is now cleared, the debris pile and wheelbarrow at the left. Ends exactly on the last image. Debris moves only on his shovel; nothing morphs or vanishes.

extra_params.negative_prompt: morphing, debris vanishing or appearing on its own, objects popping in or out, teleporting tools, camera movement, zoom, pan, dissolve, crossfade, different person, different railcar, on-screen text, blur, distort, low quality

schema_check.multi_prompt: optional list of {prompt, duration '1'..'15'}; 'Either prompt or multi_prompt must be provided, but not both.'
schema_check.end_image_url: optional; no stated restriction against multi_prompt
schema_check.verdict: ACCEPTED BY SCHEMA, NOT CONFIRMED: fal's schema allows both together and states no exclusivity; Kling's own VIDEO 3.0 guide is silent; a third-party Kling host (LetzAI) says multi-shot is 'not compatible' with first/last frame. The combination can only be confirmed by a real submission: a 4xx rejection costs nothing; a silent drop of the end frame would still bill.
schema_check.no_aspect_ratio_field: aspect comes from the 9:16 start still

cost.basis: Kling v3 Standard $0.084/s with audio off x 6 s (fal model page, 2026-09-28)

supersedes.why: fal 422: each multi_prompt shot prompt must be <= 512 characters (ours were 943-1115); no video was generated.

prompt_packaging: Kling v3 takes EITHER prompt OR multi_prompt, so with multi_prompt there is no shared prompt field. The shared constraints live in negative_prompt (no morphing, vanishing debris, camera moves or identity drift) and in the start still; each shot keeps only a short identity/camera anchor plus its own location, action and state.
